# VultaCore

> A unified developer and cybersecurity platform combining AI-powered assistance, real-time analytics, community forums, and security tooling — all in one dashboard.

## About

VultaCore is a SaaS platform built for developers and security researchers. It provides AI mini-bots, dev and cybersecurity forums with reputation points, analytics, enterprise features, and downloadable desktop app releases.

- Base URL: https://vultacore.techprogression.com
- Contact: support@techprogression.com
- Organization: TechProgression
- License: Commercial (see /pricing for plans)

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/) — Platform overview and navigation hub
- [Developer Forum](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/forum/dev) — Q&A forum with reputation and rewards
- [Security Forum](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/forum/cyber) — Cybersecurity discussions and tool sharing
- [AI Bots — General](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/bots/general) — General-purpose AI assistant
- [AI Bots — Cyber](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/bots/cyber) — Cybersecurity-focused AI assistant
- [Analytics](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/analytics) — Real-time usage insights and charts
- [Pricing](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/pricing) — Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans
- [Download](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/download) — Desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- [Profile](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/profile) — User profile and leaderboard
- [Settings](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/settings) — AI model and notification preferences
- [Enterprise Contact](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/enterprise-contact) — Enterprise enquiries and custom plans
- [Sign In](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/auth) — Authentication (Supabase / Google OAuth)

## API & Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Health Check](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/health) — JSON: `{status, ready:{backend,dashboard,ai}, uptime}`
- [Sitemap](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/sitemap.xml) — XML sitemap of all public pages
- [robots.txt](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/robots.txt) — Crawl policy and content-signal directives
- [MCP Server Card](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json) — MCP capabilities manifest
- [Markdown alternate](https://vultacore.techprogression.com/?format=md) — Markdown representation of the homepage
